chunks.l2:
[stav-p01-v10] From māyā's watery belly fully drawn out and made stainless — Śiva-knowledge, milked of itself: give, come, O Hara-goose, to us.

[stav-p01-v11] Even in the yoga of six-valid-means' delimitations and difference: to the undivided; to the one being of ultimate truth — an offering we bring, to Bhava, to you.

[stav-p01-v02] Who, grown great with the wealth of glory, compassion, awakening, and supreme bliss, his greatness lit by knowledge — he conquers, the undefeated.

[stav-p01-v03] To the forth-flowing drop and resonance, to the self made of pure nectar: bow; to endless light, to Śaṅkara, the milk-ocean.

[stav-p01-v04] You we hate, you we hymn, with you we counsel — O Ambikā’s lord: lightly won, how good — the whole world you have borne for us.

[stav-p01-v05] To the yoked withdrawn touch, to the full-streamed nectar, to the sky-and-māyā-formed: to the vast one, to Śambhu — bow.

[stav-p01-v06] Among the split, not split; among the cut, wholly uncut — we bow to that all-common form of the supreme Lord.

[stav-p01-v07] Subtler than praṇava's upper half-mora — to the minute, and again to the great; vaster than the world-egg — to the qualified-by-qualitylessness, to Sthāṇu: bow.

[stav-p01-v08] The world-egg-bearing one — of the sky-pervading, of the all-going, of the supreme-Lord-goose — that power, goose-like, we praise.

[stav-p01-v09] With no provision of material, on no wall at all, they spread the world-picture — bow to him, the art-praised trident-bearer.
chunks.sanskrit: yaḥ sphītaḥ śrīdayābodhaparamānandasampadā vidyoddyotitamāhātmyaḥ sa jayaty aparājitaḥ prasaradbindunādāya śuddhāmṛtamayātmane namo 'nantaprakāśāya śaṃkarakṣīrasindhave dviṣmas tvāṃ tvāṃ stumas tubhyaṃ mantrayāmo 'mbikāpate ativāllabhyataḥ sādhu viśvaṅ no dhṛtavān asi saṃhṛtasparśayogāya sampūrṇāmṛtasūtaye viyanmāyāsvarūpāya vibhave śambhave namaḥ bhinneṣv api na bhinnaṃ yac chinneṣv achinnam eva ca namāmaḥ sarvasāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ tat pārameśvaram praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahmāṇḍād api nairguṇyaguṇāya sthāṇave namaḥ brahmāṇḍagarbhiṇīṃ vyomavyāpinaḥ sarvatogateḥ parameśvarahaṃsasya śaktiṃ haṃsīm iva stumaḥ nirupādānasambhāram abhittāv eva tanvate jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline māyājalodarāt samyag uddhṛtya vimalīkṛtam śivajñānaṃ svato dugdhaṃ dehy ehi harahaṃsa naḥ ṣaṭpramāṇīparicchedabhedayoge 'py abhedine paramārthaikabhāvāya baliṃ yāmo bhavāya te

chunks.l2:
[stav-p02-v12] May we see the deep — circled by supreme light, its darkness wiped, lovely — and dwell within your cave.

[stav-p02-v13] Homage to them even — who see the moon-crested lord, giver of supreme bliss, even in dream.

[stav-p02-v14] O Blessed — be! — the desire to contemplate your-ish being, skilled at cutting rebirth-fear: to whom is it not pleasing?

[stav-p02-v15] Lifelong, O world-lord, let this be our task: staying, by your grace, with mind single-pointed on you alone.

[stav-p02-v16] To the self made of thousand-branch-spread Veda and Āgama: bow; to Śambhu, the wish-tree of endless fruit.

[stav-p02-v17] Having entrusted speech, mind, body's acts in you, O Lord — become you-made, pair-free: may we be, at any time?

[stav-p02-v18] In the creation-and-dissolution appointments for each welfare of worlds — to the independently powerful, to the trident-bearer: bow.

[stav-p02-v19] Of the chief meditation-object past guṇa-yoga, of Dhūrjaṭi — even the name: for meditators, by meditations, what fruit by other supports?

[stav-p02-v20] Bow, bow — 'to Śiva' thus said: by mantra-power taking refuge, praiseworthy they who strive to enjoy Śāmbhavī fortune.

[stav-p02-v21] What path by which unattainable? What speech by which unspoken? What meditation by which unmeditated? What — what are you not, O Lord?
chunks.sanskrit: api paśyema gambhīrāṃ pareṇa jyotiṣābhitaḥ unmṛṣṭatamasaṃ ramyām antarbhava bhavadguhām namas tebhyo 'pi ye somakalākalitaśekharam nāthaṃ svapne 'pi paśyanti paramānandadāyinam bhagavan bhava bhāvatkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvayituṃ ruciḥ punarbhavabhayocchedadakṣā kasmai na rocate yāvajjīvaṃ jagannātha kartavyam idam astu naḥ tvatprasādāt tvadekāgramanaskatvena yā sthitiḥ śākhāsahasravistīrṇavedāgamamayātmane namo 'nantaphalotpādakalpavṛkṣāya śambhave vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya nirdvandvāḥ kaccit syāmāpi karhicit jagatāṃ sargasaṃhāratattaddhitaniyuktiṣu ananyāpekṣasāmarthyaśālini śūline namaḥ vyatītaguṇayogasya mukhyadhyeyasya dhūrjaṭeḥ nāmāpi dhyāyatāṃ dhyānaiḥ kim anyālambanaiḥ phalam namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ ślāghyās te śāmbhavīṃ bhūtim upabhoktuṃ ya udyatāḥ kaḥ panthā yena na prāpyaḥ kā ca vāṅ nocyase yayā kiṃ dhyānaṃ yena na dhyeyaḥ kiṃ vā kiṃ nāsi yat prabho

chunks.l2:
[stav-p03-v22] Worshipped this, meditated this, pleased this — thus this rasa: by thousand streams, in you, my — O Bhava — may it grow.

[stav-p03-v23] Bow to the self abode of intellect-lords' garland; to the Lord, to Sthāṇu, to you — serpent-sacrifice-thread-wearing.

[stav-p03-v24] Of ignorance-darkness, the one medicine: remembrance of you; O Bhava, by its giving let grace be done in me.

[stav-p03-v25] Bow to Īśa, fulfiller of all human ends; to-be-offered — the homage even — whose here, of the wise?

[stav-p03-v26] By the immersed in the terrible bhava-ocean, abode of suffering-fish — having obtained Śārva's devotion-jewel: what not conquered?

[stav-p03-v27] Of unobstructed, pairless, steady knowledge-wealth: to-be-known you are indeed — who even are these who know you, O Dhūrjaṭi?

[stav-p03-v28] Qualityless even — of quality-knowers the to-be-known, one conquers, the unborn; desireless even, by nature — who is desires' supreme fruit.

[stav-p03-v29] For Śrī-jewel-nectar gain, labored where not by which gods? That milk-ocean lordship: yours alone, natural, O Lord.

[stav-p03-v30] Bow — by devotion, for men's liberation, he blossoms: O Bhava, to you, O Protector — by remembrance and praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in non-bhava.

[stav-p03-v31] All-knowing, all-doing, all you are — thus, of knowers: what knowable, what karma, O lord — for endlessness, offered by you?
chunks.sanskrit: arcito 'yam ayaṃ dhyāta eṣa toṣita ity ayam rasaḥ srotaḥsahasreṇa tvayi me bhava vardhatām namo niḥśeṣadhīpatrimālālayamayātmane nāthāya sthāṇave tubhyaṃ nāgayajñopavītine ajñānatimirasyaikam auṣadhaṃ saṃsmṛtis tava bhava tattatpradānena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi nama īśāya niḥśeṣapuruṣārthaprasādhakaḥ praṇantavyaḥ praṇāmo 'pi yadīya iha dhīmatām magnair bhīme bhavāmbhodhau nilaye duḥkhayādasām bhakticintāmaṇiṃ śārvaṃ tataḥ prāpya na kiṃ jitam nirāvaraṇanirdvandvaniścalajñānasampadām jñeyo 'si kila ke 'py ete ye tvāṃ jānanti dhūrjaṭe nirguṇo 'pi guṇajñānāṃ jñeya eko jayaty ajaḥ niṣkāmo 'pi prakṛtyā yaḥ kāmanānāṃ paraṃ phalam śrīratnāmṛtalābhāya kliṣṭaṃ yatra na kaiḥ suraiḥ tat kṣīrodadam aiśvaryaṃ tavaiva sahajaṃ vibho namo bhaktyā nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhavate bhava te 'vate smṛtyā nutyā ca dadate śambhave śaṃ bhave 'bhave sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛt sarvam asīti jñānaśālinām vedyaṃ kiṃ karma vā nātha nānantyāya tvayārpyate

chunks.l2:
[stav-p04-v32] This whole of three worlds fruits from mere will of yours alone — who, O lord, knows the reach of your workings?

[stav-p04-v33] To him I bow, by whose stairway of works even Brahmā and the rest climb higher and higher to win the abode.

[stav-p04-v34] 'Here is Brahmā, here the Great Indra, here sun and moon' — so his power-vine stands in bloom: may Bhava, that one, guard us.

[stav-p04-v35] Deluded hearts find no delusion in him; far-rangers never reach his end — hard ground at dusk: Mṛḍa we praise.

[stav-p04-v36] Homage in hymn and memory, in meditation, sight, touch, and likewise in arrival — to the beloved mass of bliss, the matted-haired.

[stav-p04-v37] Thinking in mind, 'why this pride?', O highest Lord — 'proud, I am made of you' — ah me, not in myself: what joy is this?

[stav-p04-v38] Pondered though crores of duties be, through mind's restlessness — I rest, O Bhava, and revel deeply in the bliss of mind in you.

[stav-p04-v39] Subtle though you be, how is this triple world a mere fragment of yours? Gross though you be, why do even Brahmā and the rest not plainly see you, O lord?

[stav-p04-v40] Had it never been that 'you alone speak them all' — which sage, O god, would ever have strained through tangled words?

[stav-p04-v41] Through what practice, what rite, what wisdom does one behold you, O lord — teach me, and let your favour fall on me.
chunks.sanskrit: icchāyā eva yasyeyat phalaṃ lokatrayātmakam tasya te nātha kāryāṇāṃ ko vetti kiyatī gatiḥ brahmādayo 'pi tad yasya karmasopānamālayā upary upari dhāvanti labdhuṃ dhāma namāmi tam ayaṃ brahmā mahendro 'yaṃ sūryācandramasāv imau iti śaktilatā yasya puṣpitā pātv asau bhavaḥ bhramo na labhyate yasya bhrāntāntaḥkaraṇair api dūragair api yasyānto durgam astaṃ stumo mṛḍam namaḥ stutau smṛtau dhyāne darśane sparśane tathā prāptau cānandavṛndāya dayitāya kapardine kiṃ smayeneti matvāpi manasā parameśvara smayena tvanmayo 'smīti māmi nātmani kiṃ mudā cintayitvāpi kartavyakoṭīś cittasya cāpalāt viśrāmyan bhava bhāvatkacittānande rame bhṛśam sūkṣmo 'pi cet trilokīyaṃ kalāmātraṃ kathaṃ tava sthūlo 'tha kiṃ sudarśo na brahmādibhir api prabho vācya eṣāṃ tvam eveti nābhaviṣyad idaṃ yadi kaḥ kleśaṃ deva vāgjāleṣv akariṣyat sudhīs tadā krameṇa karmaṇā kena kayā vā prajñayā prabho dṛśyo 'sīty upadeśena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama

chunks.l2:
[stav-p05-v42] I bow to the unserved servitor of all three worlds; to him whom all crave, who craves nothing, the matted hair.

[stav-p05-v43] Ah, see the good ones' discernment for that high task — how they sow undying-fruited love in you, O lord.

[stav-p05-v44] Ah, vast is that glamour of yours, O trickster — shrouded in it, the dazed folk turn slack though the hoard of thought on you lie gained.

[stav-p05-v45] Let every venture start, O Bhava — deed, instrument, world, what you will — yet the deed's free master there is you alone.

[stav-p05-v46] Gripped are the triple worlds in triple-gun throbbing pairs — to haul them out, besides you whose might, whose mercy?

[stav-p05-v47] What blame is blame in a man bent on winning you, even O god? What worth is worth, pray, in a man bent on never winning you? Be passion mine, world-lord, fastened on you alone — and homage even to my greed, leashed to gaining you.

[stav-p05-v48] Ah, mighty is this rite, O god — thinking on you: wherein from Brahmā down to the worm, which of us lacks title to release?

[stav-p05-v49] The start of every work, the close of every rite, the shifting play between — all yours indeed, O lord, along wisdom's road.

[stav-p05-v50] As higher rises the thousandfold tide of savour — nowhere but in love's nectar-liqueur for you, O lord, is it found.
chunks.sanskrit: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine aho kṣetrajñatā seyaṃ kāryāya mahate satām yayānantaphalāṃ bhaktiṃ vapanti tvayy amī prabho mahatīyam aho māyā tava māyin yayāvṛtaḥ tvaddhyānanidhilābhe 'pi mugdho lokaḥ ślathāyate ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān triguṇatriparispandadvandvagrastaṃ jagattrayam uddhartuṃ bhavato 'nyasya kasya śaktiḥ kṛpāthavā doṣo 'pideva ko doṣas tvām āptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ guṇo 'pi ca guṇaḥ ko nu tvāṃ nāptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ rāgo 'py astu jagannātha mama tvayy eva yaḥ sthitaḥ lobhāyāpi namas tasmai tvallābhālambanāya me aho mahad idaṃ karma deva tvadbhāvanātmakam ābrahmakrimi yasmin no muktaye 'dhikriyeta kaḥ ārambhaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ paryantaḥ sarvakarmaṇām tadantarvṛttayaś citrās tavaiveśo dhiyaḥ pathi yāvad uttaram āsvādasahasraguṇavistaraḥ tvadbhaktirasapīyūṣān nātha nānyatra dṛśyate

chunks.l2:
[stav-p06-v51] Homage to Soma master — his longing drawn in, desire stretched long, the moon his crest.

[stav-p06-v52] Crying 'incapable, what can I do?' with nowhere a resolve to stand on — Śaṅkara's grace that befriends all is where I hide.

[stav-p06-v53] You stand past the strands, yourself proclaimed sheer wonder — in what corner, Bhava, could a second you be found?

[stav-p06-v54] Nondual you are, boundless self, O lord — and still your fathomless glamour fools us now.

[stav-p06-v55] Powers from the minute on, undying lordship, becoming's end — Bhava, these are green shoots of the prayer-tree rooted in you.

[stav-p06-v56] No direction lacks you; all hours are your stuff — won already, yet when, lord, shall I win you? Speak.

[stav-p06-v57] Homage, Śambhu — lone tenant of lucid honest hearts, ash-white limbs, high swan.

[stav-p06-v58] Scatter the surging gloom, burn every stick of becoming — be my lamp of waking, lord, my lamp of love.

[stav-p06-v59] You set the triple-world drama teeming with live seed — Hara, to strike the set, what playwright but you has skill?

[stav-p06-v60] Homage to turn the real and the fake to nought or to aught — to the bound and the free, who wears wasting and sway as one.
chunks.sanskrit: upasaṃhṛtakāmāya kāmāyatim atanvate avataṃsitasomāya somāya svāmine namaḥ kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama guṇātītasya nirdiṣṭaniḥśeṣātiśayātmanaḥ labhyate bhava kutrāṃśe paraḥ pratinidhis tava nirdvandve nirupādhau ca tvayy ātmani sati prabho vayaṃ vañcyāmahe 'dyāpi māyayāmeyayā tava aṇimādiguṇāvāptiḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ bhavakṣayaḥ amī bhava bhavadbhaktikalpapādapapallavāḥ yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ lapsyase nātha kathyatām namaḥ prasannasadvṛttamānasaikanivāsine bhūribhūtisitāṅgāya mahāhaṃsāya śambhave hṛtoddhatatamastāntiḥ pluṣṭāśeṣabhavendhanā tvadbodhadīpikā me 'stu nātha tvadbhaktidīpikā visṛṣṭānekasadbījagarbhaṃ trailokyanāṭakam prastāvya hara saṃhartuṃ tvattaḥ ko 'nyaḥ kaviḥ kṣamaḥ namaḥ sadasatāṃ kartum asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā svatantrāyāsvatantrāya vyayaiśvaryaikaśāline

chunks.l2:
[stav-p07-v61] Any joy glimpsed here in all three worlds — a droplet of whom? To that sea-of-bliss god I bend.

[stav-p07-v62] Ah, lucky Brahmā and the rest — dropped all chatter, drunk with delight they mumble: Śiva, hail, hail.

[stav-p07-v63] Hail the hungerless apportioner of hunger without end; though the world never began, its feaster — Bhava, take my bow.

[stav-p07-v64] The lord we laud, taproot of the triple world's start — who would beg a favour of the flawless?

[stav-p07-v65] Sunk in dire straits, muddied by floods of folly — let him be recalled, and minds grow lucid: Śiva we sing.

[stav-p07-v66] Lord, from you only, unbroken sway holds here — at whose nod the three worlds fold and unfold.

[stav-p07-v67] Aim filth at him and it turns sterling; aim merit elsewhere — O, nowhere else such alchemy.

[stav-p07-v68] 'Caught in our fist, caught in our sight — where will you slip from us?' — so, drunk on love's sap, the lucky sprint for the Matted One.

[stav-p07-v69] You we laud — sung in verse, formula, chant, from light, from farther, farthest — your lore-body to be known — ah, sombre and fair.

[stav-p07-v70] Law and start and close of the world are you, high Lord — the host of duties marched out: unissued from you, whence could it march?
chunks.sanskrit: trailokye 'py atra yo yāvān ānandaḥ kaścid īkṣyate sa bindur yasya taṃ vande devam ānandasāgaram aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te stumas tribhuvanārambhamūlaprakṛtim īśvaram lipseran nopakāraṃ ke yataḥ sampūrṇadharmaṇaḥ mahatsv apy arthakṛcchreṣu mohaughamalinīkṛtāḥ smṛte yasmin prasīdanti matayas taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ prabho bhavata eveha prabhuśaktir abhaṅgurā yadicchayā pratāyete trailokyasya layodayau kukarmāpi yam uddiśya devaṃ syāt sukṛtaṃ param sukṛtasyāpi saukṛtyaṃ yato 'nyatra na so 'si bhoḥ eṣa muṣṭyā gṛhīto 'si dṛṣṭa eṣa kva yāsi naḥ iti bhaktirasādhmātā dhanyā dhāvanti dhūrjaṭim stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī vidhir ādis tathānto 'si viśvasya parameśvara dharmagrāmaḥ pravṛtto yas tvatto na sa kuto bhavet

chunks.l2:
[stav-p08-v71] To you I bow — you conjure the churned stupor of becoming, then shatter it: bliss of gnosis, no pairs — O god, veiler and unveiler.

[stav-p08-v72] What longings could sound her farthest shore — her who filches glamour in a single blink? Śiva, keep us.

[stav-p08-v73] Freedom's hard road, wisdom's high crown, hunger's last ridge — their bearer, lord, is you.

[stav-p08-v74] Brahmā himself has Brahmā in you; what master owns no master in you, master of masters? Bliss of the world's bliss — who gauges how huge you are?

[stav-p08-v75] Kinsmen avail what, comrades what, patrons what? My lord, in every strait it is you who hauls us off the sea of birth.

[stav-p08-v76] Hail the heaven-dew beads — hauled by discipline's force, strong to rinse folly, glamour, grime.

[stav-p08-v77] The chant hymns his thought-kindling blaze — O may he urge our minds down the straight track, our lord.

[stav-p08-v78] Eight-bodied one — in one body at least, grant us ground that holds; or glad-hearted, grant us everything.

[stav-p08-v79] Things prove their truth by work they do — but your bare name, lord, perfects through to release.

[stav-p08-v80] Stage after stage you reset the painted world, ever and again — lord, at that craft of yours, what keen heart is not stunned?
chunks.sanskrit: namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate yasyāḥ prāpyeta paryantaviśeṣaḥ kair manorathaiḥ māyām ekanimeṣeṇa muṣṇaṃs tāṃ pātu naḥ śivaḥ vairāgyasya gatiṃ gurvīṃ jñānasya paramāṃ śriyam naiḥspṛhyasya parāṃ koṭiṃ bibhratāṃ tvaṃ prabho prabhuḥ brahmaṇo 'pi bhavān brahma kasya neśas tvam īśituḥ jagatkalyāṇakalyāṇaṃ kiyat tvam iti vetti kaḥ kim anyair bandhubhiḥ kiṃ ca suhṛdbhiḥ svāmibhis tathā sarvasthāne mameśa tvaṃ ya uddhartā bhavārṇavāt jayanti mohamāyādimalasaṃkṣālanakṣamāḥ śaivayogabalākṛṣṭā divyapīyūṣavipruṣaḥ gāyatryā gīyate yasya dhiyāṃ tejaḥ pracodakam codayed api kaccin naḥ sa dhiyaḥ satpathe prabhuḥ aṣṭamūrte kim ekasyām api mūrtau na naḥ sthitim śāśvatīṃ kuruṣe yad vā tuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyasi vastutattvaṃ padārthānāṃ prāyeṇārthakriyākaram bhavatas tv īśa nāmāpi mokṣaparyantasiddhidam muhur muhur jagaccitrasy-ānyānyāṃ sthitim ūhitum śaktir yā te tayā nātha ko manasvī na vismitaḥ

chunks.l2:
[stav-p09-v81] Make the hard handy and sweeten the bitter — his memory alone is valiant: him we mind, the lover's bane.

[stav-p09-v82] Long live the hymns that sing the high lord — at whose bare name the great break out in bristling thrill.

[stav-p09-v83] Were you as you are, O Becoming, in the beyond — your hosts of power marshalled to launch and close the triple world.

[stav-p09-v84] Spell you are, spell-fit you are, spell-master — what second wizard besides you? Come, hand me that spell, lord, that I turn spellbound to you.

[stav-p09-v85] Light-shaped, vow-true — the self in you is mine, am I: yet called a drifter — O lord, what dream is this, and how in you?

[stav-p09-v86] Unsnapped, unchurlish, single, sound — in you, lord, stands the fortune of men who stake their harvest on you.

[stav-p09-v87] Strong to crush what ills, to deal what boons — or not? Here he is, our darling, god of gods on the bull-flag.

[stav-p09-v88] For god-sight filmed with inborn stain, lord, your love is the last salve that rinses clean.

[stav-p09-v89] Fear-free, bliss-full, one, unwasting — plant that foothold in me, come, god — quick, why linger?

[stav-p09-v90] Ah, bottomless and grim, the drowning sea of rounds; ah, to ferry it — some high one — great Master.
chunks.sanskrit: duṣkaraṃ sukarīkartuṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhayituṃ tathā ekavīrā smṛtir yasya taṃ smarāmaḥ smaradviṣam jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ mantro 'si mantraṇīyo 'si mantrī tvattaḥ kuto 'paraḥ sa mahyaṃ dehi taṃ mantraṃ tvanmantraḥ syāṃ yathā prabho bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi tad abhaṅgi tad agrāmyaṃ tad ekam upapattimat tvayi karmaphalanyāsakṛtām aiśvaryam īśa yat kṣamaḥ kāṃ nāpadaṃ hantuṃ kāṃ dātuṃ sampadaṃ na vā yo 'sau sa dayito 'smākaṃ devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam nirbhayaṃ yad yad ānandamayam ekaṃ yad avyayam padaṃ dehy ehi me deva tūrṇaṃ tat kiṃ pratīkṣase aho nisargagambhīro ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ aho tattaraṇopāyaḥ paraḥ ko 'pi maheśvaraḥ

chunks.l2:
[stav-p10-v100] Hail, triple world's king, hail to you, Becoming — hailed by your court — hail the unbarred might that bestows triple kingship.

[stav-p10-v91] I bow to you — death's ender, love's crusher, Gaṅgā crowned on the pate, worker of meet right.

[stav-p10-v92] High past sway and gnosis, past dispassion and writs stands what men pray for — cut off from you, lord, what loftier haven for the praying?

[stav-p10-v93] Should you not wish it, Śambhu, who could crook a straw? Graced by your wish — who would shirk Brahmā's burden?

[stav-p10-v94] The brain-rich, crests high with gemmy wreaths from bending to Hara — to what Highest would they kneel, whom would they not incline?

[stav-p10-v95] Quiverless, quit of every stray, a mere of sweet — O let me settle in mid-sea of your knowing, Matted One.

[stav-p10-v96] A marvel — eyed askance though it be, strayed into fancy though it be — the last fruit, lord, you grant entire.

[stav-p10-v97] What strong soul outtops you? What stringless soul outpeaks you? So, lord, we sing — bless you? curse you? We cannot say.

[stav-p10-v98] Though we hymn but the spate of sweet — whose grace fruits in you — to sip it, what stranger is fit? To serve it round — O world-king, who then?

[stav-p10-v99] Out of the hoard where every coveted sheaf ripens — from you I beg one thing, lord, in all wise: love of you solely to win.
chunks.sanskrit: namaḥ kṛtakṛtāntānta tubhyaṃ madanamardine mastakanyastagaṅgāya yathāyuktārthakāriṇe aiśvaryajñānavairāgyadharmebhyo 'py upari sthitim nātha prārthayamānānāṃ tvad ṛte kā parā gatiḥ tvayy anicchati kaḥ śambho śaktaḥ kubjayituṃ tṛṇam tvadicchānugṛhītas tu vahed brāhmīṃ dhuraṃ na kaḥ harapraṇatimāṇikyamukuṭotkaṭamastakāḥ nameyuḥ kaṃ paraṃ kaṃ vā namayeyur na dhīdhanāḥ sarvavibhramanirmokaniṣkampam amṛtahradam bhavajjñānāmbudher madhyam adhyāsīyāpi dhūrjaṭe citraṃ yac citradṛṣṭo 'pi manorathagato 'pi vā paramārthaphalaṃ nātha paripūrṇaṃ prayacchasi ko guṇair adhikas tvattas tvattaḥ ko nirguṇo 'dhikaḥ iti nātha numaḥ kiṃ tvāṃ kiṃ nindāmo na manmahe kīrtane 'py amṛtaughasya yatprasatteḥ phalaṃ tava tat pātum api ko 'nyo 'laṃ kim u dātuṃ jagatpate niḥśeṣaprārthanīyārthasārthasiddhinidhānataḥ tvattas tvadbhaktim evāptuṃ prārthaye nātha sarvathā namas trailokyanāthāya tubhyaṃ bhava bhavajjuṣām trilokīnāthatādānanirvināyakaśaktaye

chunks.l2:
[stav-p11-v101] When men doubt what uproots all ache — master, resolved 'that art thou' — who has failed to flee to you?

[stav-p11-v102] Tasted my fill and shed birth's mirage, I shall win the highest seat — so hope runs here: bright may it blaze for Śambhu's lover.

[stav-p11-v103] Lord, in dreams too, do or utter I foul or fair — proud to hang on you — at home in all places I rest glad.

[stav-p11-v104] What lamp of lamps — there, where mind races in your dwelling — mind's lord, could murk touch it? As soon, I deem, as a barren dame's grandson.

[stav-p11-v105] Methinks one foot already on kind release's road stands he whose hankering runs: 'Śiva I'll honour' — even this.

[stav-p11-v106] Through keeping, kindling, killing, in this triple world's errands — yours only, lord, the might — unbound — you watch the weave.

[stav-p11-v107] Saved in these three worlds, unscorched by triple smart — hail him, hail you — you, the dead-quiet mere of sweet.

[stav-p11-v108] Feigned love of you still ripens true — were it straight, O what crop? Pronounce it, you.

[stav-p11-v109] The eye that sights you, the road that attains you — that yield, Unborn, springs from the gossip-grove grown of you.

[stav-p11-v110] Best past the good, this poise on high in you — to sweep its hindrances, lord, you are my hold.
chunks.sanskrit: niḥśeṣakleśahānasya hetuḥ ka iti saṃśaye svāmin so 'sīti niścitya kas tvāṃ na śaraṇaṃ gataḥ bhuktvā bhogān bhavabhrāntiṃ hitvā lapsye paraṃ padam ity āśaṃseha śobheta śambhau bhaktimataḥ param nātha svapne 'pi yat kuryāṃ brūyāṃ vā sādhv asādhu vā tvadadhīnatvadarpeṇa sarvatrātrāsmi nirvṛtaḥ jyotiṣām api yaj jyotis tatra tvaddhāmni dhāvataḥ cittasyeśa tamaḥsparśo manye vandhyātmajānujaḥ manye nyastapadaḥ so 'pi kṣemye mokṣasya vartmani manorathaḥ sthito yasya seviṣye śivam ity ayam sthityutpattilayair lokatrayasyopakriyāsv iha ekaiveśa bhavacchaktiḥ svatantraṃ tantram īkṣase trilokyām iha kas trātas tritāpyā nopatāpitaḥ tasmai namo 'stu te yas tvaṃ tannirvāṇāmṛtahradaḥ kṛtrimāpi bhavadbhaktir akṛtrimaphalodayā niśchadmā ced bhaved eṣā kiṃphaleti tvayocyatām tac cakṣur īkṣyase yena sā gatir gamyase yayā phalaṃ tad aja jātaṃ yat tvatkathākalpapādapāt śreyasā śreya evaitad upari tvayi yā sthitiḥ tadantarāyahṛtaye tvam īśa śaraṇaṃ mama

chunks.l2:
[stav-p12-v111] Ah, honeyed past honey, the savour of serving Śarva hoped — in what tick of time does it not turn ever-new?

[stav-p12-v112] Ever, unwearied, teeming the triple world with hundredfold fancies — yet single, seamless, lords it — Unborn.

[stav-p12-v113] By lore's lamp that licks the birth-greased wick of wonts — god, O when shall I stand in your presence, prithee?

[stav-p12-v114] Grant one blinking's room with faults outworn to lodge within the breast — then, Śambhu, what feat past your doing?

[stav-p12-v115] 'Blest am I, quits am I, big am I' — firm would that fancy stand, grounded — his whom you ground, lord.

[stav-p12-v116] Luck and muck alike you author yourself — yet love of you mothers luck only, solely, lord.

[stav-p12-v117] Mind pellucid, master — step you in, or at your stepping does it clear? So dangles man.

[stav-p12-v118] Nay, here stands sure — your oversight and yours only: mind's favour, master, is fulfilment, the farthest seat.

[stav-p12-v119] Word and wit, work and this frame of mine, lord — grace them to gleam with love of you and nought beside.

[stav-p12-v120] This praise-gem, heavy with granted longings, Lakṣmī's lodging of love — for Śambhu wrought Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa.
chunks.sanskrit: aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ malatailāktasaṃsāravāsanāvartidāhinā jñānadīpena deva tvāṃ kadā nu syām upasthitaḥ nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhaktis tu jananī śubhasyaiveśa kevalam prasanne manasi svāmin kiṃ tvaṃ niviśase kim u tvatpraveśāt prasīdet tad iti dolāyate janaḥ niścayaḥ punar eṣo 'tra tvadadhiṣṭhānam eva hi prasādo manasaḥ svāmin sā siddhis tat paraṃ padam vacaś cetaś ca kāryaṃ ca śarīraṃ mama yat prabho tvatprasādena tad bhūyād bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt
